name: Wix MCP
description: Builds and manages Wix sites from your AI agent: searches Wix docs, writes Wix API and SDK code, and runs site actions for stores, bookings and contacts.

skills.name: Search Wix Docs
skills.description: Searches Wix developer documentation and pulls full articles or API method schemas, such as a method's exact parameters.

skills.name: Write Wix Code
skills.description: Generates REST or SDK code against Wix APIs, such as code that registers visitors for an event in a headless project.

skills.name: Call Site APIs
skills.description: Performs real actions on a Wix site, like applying a discount to store products, adding a bookings staff member or emailing a contact.

skills.name: Manage Sites and Projects
skills.description: Creates and publishes Wix sites, installs business solutions and scaffolds new headless projects from account-level actions.
